name: Liriel
source:
Liriel was [url=https://vndb.org/c165794]Loriss[/url]' second. Loriss has been offered several leadership roles in various cities around the Kingdom. However, Liriel knows Ban Ardor is where the action at a time when history is being made. for now, Liriel is content to serve as an average assassin and lead teams on missions.
